title: Grammar Games at Home: Jeopardy
titleZh: 家庭语法游戏：危险边缘
credits: Alice Bryant wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: Hi, everyone!
sentences.zh: 大家好！

sentences.en: You might be reading or listening to this Everyday Grammar program from your living room or bedroom.
sentences.zh: 你可能正坐在客厅或卧室里阅读或收听这期"每日语法"节目。

sentences.en: In fact, you might be even wearing pajamas, no matter the time of day.
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论白天黑夜，你可能还穿着睡衣。

sentences.en: If you are like us here in Washington, D.C. and many other places, health officials have asked you to stay at home for now.
sentences.zh: 如果你和我们一样身处华盛顿特区以及许多其他地方，卫生官员目前请你们待在家中。

sentences.en: And with so many people at home for long periods, people are looking for activities to keep their minds occupied.
sentences.zh: 由于许多人长时间待在家中，大家开始寻找各种活动来充实自己的思绪。

sentences.en: Too much time on social media can be a problem.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上花费过多时间可能成为一个问题。

sentences.en: Even binge-watching movies and television shows loses its appeal after a while.
sentences.zh: 即使连续刷剧看电影和电视节目，过一段时间也会失去吸引力。

sentences.en: With this in mind, we will be offering ideas for games that you can play with your family or housemates in the coming weeks to practice your English.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，在未来几周里，我们将提供各种游戏创意，你可以和家人或室友一起玩，借此练习英语。

sentences.en: On today’s program we will talk about Jeopardy, a favorite game of English learning classrooms.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将介绍"危险边缘"游戏，这是英语学习课堂中深受喜爱的游戏之一。

sentences.en: The idea comes from the American television game show in which players give their answers in the form of a question.
sentences.zh: 这个创意源自美国电视游戏节目，节目中选手以提问的形式给出答案。

sentences.en: You may have even seen the show in your country.
sentences.zh: 你可能在自己的国家看过这个节目。

sentences.en: In Jeopardy, players choose from categories and try to win money, like this:
sentences.zh: 在"危险边缘"游戏中，选手从各类主题中选择，并试图赢得奖金，就像这样：

sentences.en: (Player) I’ll take Countries for $100.
sentences.zh: （选手）我选"国家"，价值100美元。

sentences.en: (Host) This Asian country is famous for its high-quality motorcycles (Player) What is Japan?
sentences.zh: （主持人）这个亚洲国家以其高品质摩托车而闻名（选手）日本是什么？

sentences.en: (Host) That is correct!
sentences.zh: （主持人）回答正确！

sentences.en: Notice that the answer came in the form of a question: “What is Japan?”
sentences.zh: 请注意，答案是以提问的形式给出的："日本是什么？"

sentences.en: You will also note the host read a fact in statement form.
sentences.zh: 你还会注意到，主持人是以陈述句的形式读出相关事实的。

sentences.en: We will call those facts clues.
sentences.zh: 我们将把这些事实称为线索。

sentences.en: Playing Jeopardy at home is a good way to get experience forming questions in English.
sentences.zh: 在家中玩"危险边缘"游戏，是练习用英语组织问题的一个好方法。

sentences.en: It also can improve your speaking and listening skills, and help expand your vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 它还能提升你的口语和听力技能，并帮助你扩大词汇量。

sentences.en: Now, let’s talk about how to play the game.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来谈谈如何玩这个游戏。

sentences.en: You will need three or more English learners – one person to serve as host and the others to play.*
sentences.zh: 你需要三名或三名以上的英语学习者——一人担任主持人，其他人担任玩家。*

sentences.en: There are two ways to play the game: the traditional way (with answers in question form) and the easier way, which you can find on our website at learningenglish.voanews.com.
sentences.zh: 这个游戏有两种玩法：传统玩法（答案以问句形式呈现）和更简单的玩法，你可以在我们网站learningenglish.voanews.com上找到。

sentences.en: Here is how to play the traditional way.
sentences.zh: 以下是传统玩法的具体步骤。

sentences.en: The first step is to decide who the host will be.
sentences.zh: 第一步是确定由谁来担任主持人。

sentences.en: His or her job is to gather clues for the game.
sentences.zh: 主持人的工作是为游戏收集线索。

sentences.en: The host also reads clues to the players, and keeps a record of points won.
sentences.zh: 主持人还要向玩家朗读线索，并记录所得分数。

sentences.en: To play the game, you will need five separate categories.
sentences.zh: 要玩这个游戏，你需要五个不同的类别。

sentences.en: For example, you might choose: Countries, Animals, Foods, Sports and Actors.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以选择：国家、动物、食物、运动和演员。

sentences.en: For each category, choose six clues, from easy ($100) to difficult ($600).
sentences.zh: 对于每个类别，选择六条线索，从简单（100美元）到困难（600美元）。

sentences.en: The host will need to keep the clues on a computer screen or write or print them on a small piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 主持人需要把线索显示在电脑屏幕上，或者写或打印在一小张纸上。

sentences.en: To set up the game, you will need a board or large piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 要布置游戏，你需要一块板或一张大纸。

sentences.en: (If using paper, put it on a wall for all the players to see.)
sentences.zh: （如果使用纸张，请把它贴在墙上，让所有玩家都能看到。）

sentences.en: On the large paper or board, make a grid like the simple design shown on our website.
sentences.zh: 在大纸或板上，画一个网格，就像我们网站上展示的那种简单设计。

sentences.en: Write the categories on the left of the grid and the money amounts across the top.
sentences.zh: 把类别写在网格的左侧，金额写在顶部。

sentences.en: For the full directions on how to play the game, to see how to make the grid, and for links to clues that are already prepared, go to our website.
sentences.zh: 如需完整的游戏玩法说明、了解如何制作网格，以及获取已准备好的线索链接，请访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: And join us again soon for more grammar games you can play at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请关注，稍后将会有更多语法游戏供你在家里玩。

sentences.en: I’m Alice Bryant.
sentences.zh: 我是爱丽丝·布莱恩特。

a person who lives in the same house with another person but is not a part of that person's family
to do something again and again in order to get better at it
a group of things that are similar in some way
a person who talks to players on a game show
something that helps a person find an answer to something
all of the words known and used by a person
a large, flat surface attached to a wall or supported on an easel and used for writing on with chalk or markers, especially by teachers in classrooms
